enrichment.headline: Pays Colbi Technologies $210,000 for facilities construction-tracking software and training through 2022
enrichment.summary: The district hires Colbi Technologies of Tustin to provide software services for the Facilities Planning & Management office, including phone and online support, the Account-Ability and Colbi Docs software for construction control processes, and spring and fall workshops and training. The $210,000 includes $8,000 for travel reimbursement and data integration services. Work runs from August 27, 2020 through June 30, 2022.

enrichment.summary: This amendment gives ACC Environmental Consultants 91 more days, moving the end date from August 1, 2020 to October 31, 2020. enrichment.summary: The district hires Jensen Hughes to witness the pre-test of the new Glenview building's fire alarm and intrusion alarm system and the final acceptance test of the intrusion alarm system. The fee is $12,500. Work runs from August 27, 2020 to December 31, 2020.

enrichment.headline: Pays Girls Inc. of Alameda County up to $88,558 to run West Oakland Middle's after-school program
enrichment.summary: The district signs a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Girls Inc. of Alameda County to lead West Oakland Middle School's after-school program, including program coordination, math help, homework support, student supervision and enrichment activities. The agreement is for up to $88,558 and runs from August 1, 2020 through July 31, 2021. It is funded by the After School Education and Safety (ASES) grant.

items.fundingSource: After School Education and Safety (ASES) Grant

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
